summary: In community.hrobot, the robot inventory plugin's filters option was renamed to simple_filters, and the old name stops working in 2.0.0.
questions: What do I rename filters to in the hrobot inventory?

answer_card.title: hrobot inventory filters renamed
answer_card.answer_md: Rename `filters` to `simple_filters` in the community.hrobot robot inventory config. The old name stops working in 2.0.0.
